facts.business: Grand Oak Canyons Distillery Limited (formerly Pacheli Industrial Finance Limited) is a Core Investment Company (CIC) primarily engaged in borrowing and advancing inter-corporate deposits.

auditor.name: V R S K & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The company should have prepared financial statements in compliance with IND AS as prescribed, which may significantly affect the financial statements. Comments in sub clause iii and sub clause iv of clause 4 of Companies (Auditor's Report) Order, 2020.

key_risks: Magnitude of inter-corporate deposits borrowed (Rs 2,650 cr) and advanced (Rs 403.58 cr) with variety of terms defining loan contracts
Conversion of loans to equity capital risk
Non-compliance with IND AS accounting standards
High net debt to equity ratio of 3.12
